get_vision_module: build a python module to load a ResNet encoder from torchvision and return the model with feature dimension
create_VisionModule: create a VisionModule that encodes two input tensors x_i and x_j through a shared ResNet encoder
create_VisionGameWrapper: create a VisionGameWrapper that wraps a game module with a vision encoder for sender and receiver inputs
create_Sender: create a Sender neural network module that projects visual features to a specified output dimension
create_Receiver: create a Receiver neural network module that projects visual features to a specified output dimension
